author: M_schnappi
description: Use the Left Arrow or A to move left, Right Arrow or D to move right, and Space bar to jump. Reach the goal while avoiding monsters—watch out for green monsters that will chase you! Black ghosts will randomly appear and float toward you, so stay alert! Look for hidden bonus levels to earn extra health rewards. Good luck! Collect yellow capsules to grow larger and crush monsters, and blue capsules to boost your speed and jump.
